_comment: Model properties and boundaries. context_window = max input tokens, max_output in tokens, temp_max for temperature models, thinking_max for extended thinking models. release_date = provider announcement date (release_date_assumed = family-head date, verify in next FULL run). uc_class = Universal Class (UC-1..5), eci_band = 5-point Epoch Capabilities Index band frozen at first assignment (snapshot 2026-10-28), eci_score = raw Epoch ECI score at snapshot, eci_band_source present = fallback band (sibling:<model_id> or uc_default) replaced once Epoch publishes a score; absent = Epoch. gen_equivalent = highest reference UC-1/UC-2 model with ECI <= model ECI. capability_label YY-L is script-derived: YY = release_date year, letter index = (anchor(YY) - eci_band) / 5 with anchor(YY) = 170 + 15 * (YY - 26), letters A-Z; set for every text model not retired. capability_note records R4 observation downgrades. behavior_profile per MODEL_INVENTORY.md Section 2.
